cohort: 122 Mexican women diagnosed with systemic lupus erythematosus with singleton pregnancies who received prenatal care between 2010 and 2015.
finding: Mexican women with systemic lupus erythematosus have a high incidence of pre-term birth, preeclampsia, anaemia, early onset preeclampsia, intrauterine growth restriction, oligohydramnios and caesarean birth.
mod_finding: The incidence of caesarean birth in Mexican women with systemic lupus erythematosus was high (78.2%).
